title.en: Make password sign-in the production default
title.zh: 将生产登录默认方式改为密码

purpose.en: Align SmartLingo's sign-in behavior with the portfolio Clerk password-first baseline.
purpose.zh: 将 SmartLingo 登录行为对齐全站 Clerk 密码优先基线。

en: Open sign-in and sign-up pages in password mode while retaining email code as an optional user-selected method.
Show password-default guidance in every supported interface language.
zh: 登录与注册页默认打开密码模式，同时保留由用户主动选择的邮箱验证码方式。
所有受支持界面语言均显示密码优先说明。

en: SmartLingo authentication form, localized sign-in copy, and shared authentication regression contracts.
zh: SmartLingo 身份验证表单、多语言登录文案及共享身份回归契约。

en: Switch the initial authentication state to password and remove rendered copy that claims an email code is the default.
zh: 将身份验证初始状态改为密码，并移除声称邮箱验证码为默认方式的渲染文案。

en: Pass the portfolio password-first audit, repository authentication contracts, deployment workflow, and basic production availability check.
zh: 通过全站密码优先审计、仓库身份契约、部署工作流及生产基本可用性检查。

en: Email-code authentication remains available only when the user explicitly selects it.
zh: 用户主动选择时仍可使用邮箱验证码登录。

en: Preserve SmartLingo branding, product behavior, and this site's independent Clerk, user, payment, and data boundaries.
zh: 保留 SmartLingo 品牌与产品行为，以及本站独立的 Clerk、用户、支付和数据边界。
